‘Marian Heretic’ Is Back With ‘Book Of Joan’

Alex Zalben28 seconds ago5 hours ago02 mins
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:01
Instaread

Tini Howard and Joe Jaro introduced Marian Heretic in the series of the same name from BOOM! Studios, a nun warrior fighting the supernatural in a weird, brave (and terrifying) new world. And now the character is back in a new one-shot titled Book of Joan.

Here’s the synopsis, per BOOM! Studios:

With Sister Marian sidelined by a magical affliction, Ravenna must lead Sister Joan back into the City of Vespers to confront a new order of nuns wielding their own brand of witchcraft to keep Marian and her fellow Sisters out of the City.  

Disguised as new members of the convent, Ravenna and Joan must uncover the nature of the witches’ magic—and the harm it’s inflicting upon their Holy Mother before things get too far out of hand.

Uhoh! Watch out, Marian, Ravenna and Sister Joan are coming for your job! Hope they don’t make it a [sunglasses emoji] habit.

Marian Heretic: Book of Joan #1 hits stores on February 17, 2027. Check out the cover below.
